name: Webwinkel Vakdagen 2027
cost: Visitor ticket free for retailers; check exhibitor rates
notes: Largest digital-commerce event in the Benelux: 14,000+ visitors, 270 exhibitors, 200 talks. The rooms are full of exactly our buyer: SME retail and e-commerce operators drowning in admin.

name: World Summit AI Amsterdam 2026
cost: Ticket several hundred euro; 20 min from home
notes: 10th anniversary edition. Enterprise-heavy crowd: more peers and vendors than SME buyers, but the best AI networking event in the country and it is on our doorstep.

name: The Amsterdam AI Summit 2026
notes: 500 business, innovation, product and tech leaders from across NL. Decision-makers rather than researchers: closer to our buyer than the big summit. Verify the exact November date before booking.

name: EuroCIS 2027
notes: The leading retail-technology fair in Europe. Retailers come specifically to buy technology: high intent, but bigger retailers than our sweet spot and a crowded vendor floor.

name: Spielwarenmesse 2027
notes: The world's biggest toy fair, and Durabo's entire world walks the floor. Not a lead machine for us directly, but one Durabo-style reference client turns this into a fishing pond of lookalikes.
